screening_reasoning: A review of AI/ML applications for plant disease detection and management, covering CNNs, IoT, and drones; survey without a primary UAV segmentation benchmark.
A generic CNN object-detection approach for autonomous drones across agriculture, disaster response, and surveillance; not a crop/weed image-segmentation task.
A UV-sensitive camera with YOLOv5/Faster R-CNN detects strawberry flowers from drones (mAP 0.951); a strawberry-flower detection task in a fruit domain, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

Mask R-CNN identifies and segments leaf-rust-infected areas on sugarcane leaves from UAV multispectral imagery (best F1 0.70 at 5 m altitude); DL UAV crop-disease pixel segmentation with explicit F1 metrics.
An ML-based UAV flight-path planning system with a CNN pest-detection module for arable lands; a trajectory-planning/detection study, not a crop/weed segmentation benchmark.

A deep meta-learning squeeze-and-attention CNN performs crop and weed detection with uncertainty estimation from multispectral UAV imagery, reporting mean IoU of 88.5% (crop) and 86.5% (weed); DL UAV crop/weed pixel segmentation with explicit IoU.
A transfer-learning CNN estimates citrus leaf chlorophyll content across leaf/canopy/UAV scales (R2=0.784); a biophysical trait-regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

AgriVision uses a CNN on drone imagery to detect crop diseases early with a Flask/Streamlit dashboard and weather integration; a disease-detection/decision-system task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

Lightweight U-Net variants (including ResUNet SCSE) semantically segment weeds, crops, and bare soil from low-altitude multispectral UAV imagery on WeedsGalore (weed-class IoU 77.49%, attention model -21.1% parameters vs DeepLabV3+); DL UAV crop/weed segmentation with mIoU and lightweight-efficiency trade-off.

YOLOv11n/s-seg models perform crop/weed/soil instance segmentation from UAV imagery and are INT8-quantized and deployed on a Rockchip RK3588 NPU (Orange Pi 5+, 2.6-2.7x latency reduction with ~2-3pt accuracy loss); DL agricultural pixel segmentation with explicit edge-hardware latency evidence.
A superpixel-aided multiscale CNN segments UAV imagery on the Urban Drone Dataset (UDD); generated for urban aerial scenes, not agricultural crop/weed imagery.
A systematized review of UAV + deep-learning approaches for potato weed and disease detection; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.

A YOLOv26-based instance-segmentation framework detects and localizes Potato Virus Y symptoms in seed-potato fields from low-cost RGB UAV imagery (mAP@50 ~65%, precision 73%, recall 65%); DL UAV crop-disease pixel segmentation with quantitative mask metrics.

A Faster R-CNN + U-Net pipeline detects rice plants, segments leaves, and classifies health via leaf-color comparison; an integrated health-classification pipeline rather than a crop/weed segmentation benchmark with IoU/Dice metrics.

A study quantifies resolution-accuracy trade-offs for semantic segmentation of agricultural anomalies (dryness, nutrient deficiency) on Agriculture-Vision using U-Net, R2U-Net, U-Net3+, Attention U-Net, and DeepLabV3+ with mIoU/Dice metrics across GSD levels; DL UAV agricultural pixel segmentation with explicit metrics.

A study of minimum annotation-dataset requirements for object detection of maize seedlings (YOLOv5/8/11, RT-DETR, CD-ViTO, OWLv2) on drone orthomosaics; an object-detection/counting study, not pixel-level crop segmentation.
An attention-augmented CNN classifies wheat/rice/maize diseases from drone-acquired RGB and multispectral images; a disease-classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
U-Net/CNN segment coconut trees from drone imagery and ML classifiers diagnose disease symptoms; a coconut-tree (plantation) segmentation and disease-classification task in a non-crop/weed domain.
A hybrid CNN+XGBoost model classifies crop health from high-resolution drone footage (96.4% accuracy); a crop-health classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A U-Net with spectral indices and DSM geometry quantitatively segments Cercospora-infected plants in sugar beet from UAV multispectral imagery (infected-class F1 46.0%, healthy 92.5%, overall accuracy 88.6%); DL UAV crop-disease pixel segmentation with explicit multiclass metrics.

CNN and Transformer architectures semantically segment UAV orthomosaics of Opuntia and Agave crops for vegetation-cover quantification (best Mask2Former IoU 0.897, plus Dice/BF/HD95); DL UAV crop pixel-segmentation with explicit region and boundary metrics.
A systematic review of autonomous weed detection and identification using ML/DL and computer vision; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A comparative review of modern deep-learning techniques for plant disease detection; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A systematic review (in Spanish) of UAV image-processing and deep-learning trends in precision agriculture from 2018-2024; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
An optimized CNN with an Environmental Adaptation Method classifies sugarcane diseases (89% accuracy); a disease-classification task, not pixel-level crop segmentation.
